messages.author: d3efa2468e68b15c
messages.subject: Error in annotate.WithGenicParts(myobj, gene.obj) :    unused arguments (myobj, gene.obj)
parts:
Hi,

I wish to find out methylation status of DMPK gene in BS converted amplicon samples. For this purpose, I processed the raw reads with trim_galore and followed the bismark pipeline for genome_preparation, bismark alignement, deduplication and bismark_methylation_extraction. I used human genomic DMPK gene sequence (link_to_reference) as a reference and mapped the samples against this FASTA file. After this I used deduplicate bismark to obtain a deduplicated bam file. This bam file was sorted and indexed using samtools.

I used processBismarkAln command and got a myobj from bam file. 

myobj=processBismarkAln( location =
                                "C:/Users/kalyani_patankar/Desktop/S5/pe.deduplicated_sorted.bam",
                              sample.id="S5", assembly="hg38",
                              read.context="CpG", save.folder="C:/Users/kalyani_patankar/Desktop/S5/methCall")

After This I followed the commands:

library(genomation)


gene.obj = readTranscriptFeatures(location = "C:/Users/kalyani_patankar/Desktop/S5/DMPK.bed")


annotate.WithGenicParts(myobj, gene.obj)


DMPK.bed is a bed file obtained from UCSC genome browser


I am getting the following error when I run this command.

Error in annotate.WithGenicParts(myobj, gene.obj) : 
  unused arguments (myobj, gene.obj)

How Can I resolve this?

Thanks In Advance

parts:
I think it should be..


annotateWithGeneParts(as(myDiff25p,"GRanges"),gene.obj)

also, you are annotating each object, not the difference in methylated regions.

On Thu, May 24, 2018 at 6:38 PM, Kalyani Patankar <ksp...@gmail.com> wrote:

Hi,

 

I wish to find out methylation status of DMPK gene in BS converted amplicon samples. For this purpose, I processed the raw reads with trim_galore and followed the bismark pipeline for genome_preparation, bismark alignement, deduplication and bismark_methylation_extraction. I used human genomic DMPK gene sequence (link_to_reference) as a reference and mapped the samples against this FASTA file. After this I used deduplicate bismark to obtain a deduplicated bam file. This bam file was sorted and indexed using samtools.

 

I used processBismarkAln command and got a myobj from bam file. 

 

myobj=processBismarkAln( location =
                                "C:/Users/kalyani_patankar/Desktop/S5/pe.deduplicated_sorted.bam",
                              sample.id="S5", assembly="hg38",
                              read.context="CpG", save.folder="C:/Users/kalyani_patankar/Desktop/S5/methCall")

 

After This I followed the commands:

 

library(genomation)


gene.obj = readTranscriptFeatures(location = "C:/Users/kalyani_patankar/Desktop/S5/DMPK.bed")


annotate.WithGenicParts(myobj, gene.obj)


DMPK.bed is a bed file obtained from UCSC genome browser

 

I am getting the following error when I run this command.

 

Error in annotate.WithGenicParts(myobj, gene.obj) : 

  unused arguments (myobj, gene.obj)


How Can I resolve this?

 

Thanks In Advance
